name: Sealed Azure Bag
summary: In Azshara, you are asked to retrieve a sealed bag from a Timbermaw Shaman and take it to Archmage Xylem. The request links the shaman and the mage through the bag.

sections.title: A Sealed Bag
sections.body: A Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara has the Sealed Azure Bag, and Archmage Xylem is waiting for it in the same land. You are asked to carry the bag from one to the other.

faq.q: Who has the Sealed Azure Bag?
faq.answer: A Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara has the Sealed Azure Bag.
Archmage Xylem in Azshara is to receive the Sealed Azure Bag.

faq.q: Where do I find the bag?
faq.answer: The Sealed Azure Bag is with a Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara.
